segments.ja: アルミンの図は、もう余白に名前を隠していません。アニ・レオンハート。女型の巨人の中身として、エルヴィンの前に置かれた人物です。団長は図の感情を問いません。問うのは、捕獲が確実に近いかどうかです。確実ではない、とアルミンは認めます。認めたうえで、地下を拒んだ事実が図を一段進めました。一段進んだ作戦の目標は、森と同じです。生きた中身を、壁の内側で取る。
segments.en: Armin's diagram is no longer hiding a name in the margin. Annie Leonhart. A person set in front of Erwin as the contents of the Female Titan. The Commander does not ask about the diagram's feelings. What he asks is whether capture is close to certain. Armin admits that it is not certain. Admitting that, the fact that she refused the underground still moved the diagram up one step. The goal of the operation, one step further on, is the same as in the forest. Take the living contents, this time inside the walls.

segments.titleEn: What the underground did not seal
segments.ja: 地下は、巨人化を封じる場所として選ばれていました。封じる相手が入口を拒めば、場所の意味は消えます。消えた場所の代わりに、エレンが街の上で変身する段取りが残ります。段取りは、アニが同類だと体で示す瞬間に、彼が拳を出す、というものです。出す条件は簡単で、実行は簡単ではありません。簡単ではない理由が、慈悲です。慈悲は作戦の用語に入っていません。入っていないものが、今日の最初の障害になります。
segments.en: The underground had been chosen as a place to seal titanization. If the person you mean to seal refuses the entrance, the meaning of the place disappears. In place of the disappeared place, the arrangement that remains is for Eren to transform up in the city. The arrangement is that he puts out a fist at the moment Annie shows with her body that she is the same kind. The condition is simple. Carrying it out is not. The reason it is not simple is mercy. Mercy is not in the operation's vocabulary. What is not in the vocabulary becomes today's first obstacle.

segments.titleEn: Not turning a blade on a classmate
segments.ja: エレンにとってアニは、まだ森の敵より先に、訓練の同期です。同期に刃を向けることは、トロスト区で巨人を斬った記憶と繋がりません。繋がりませんが、繋がらないことが遅延になります。遅延のあいだに、相手は装備を理解した人間の速度で動きます。エレンは動く彼女を見て、女型の巨人の筋肉を思い出します。思い出しても、拳は出ません。出ない拳を、彼は恐怖ではなく慈悲として認識します。認識は正しく、正しくても捕獲は進みません。
segments.en: For Eren, Annie is still a classmate from training before she is the enemy from the forest. Turning a blade on a classmate does not connect to his memory of cutting Titans at Trost District. It does not connect, and the missing connection becomes a delay. During the delay, the opponent moves at the speed of a human who understood the gear. Watching her move, Eren remembers the Female Titan's muscle. Even remembering, the fist does not come out. He recognizes the fist that will not come as mercy, not as fear. The recognition is correct. Even when correct, the capture does not advance.

segments.en: What is holding the mercy up is that the evidence has not yet arrived in the heart. The row of evidence is already on the desk. The way of fighting in the forest. Information that could erase Sawney and Bean inside the walls. The trace that Marco's gear did not match the number of people. All of it makes it hard to leave one classmate outside the malice. Even when it is hard, Eren cannot convert the row into a fist. While he cannot, Armin repeats the evidence. Repetition is persuasion. Persuasion is not the switch for titanization.

segments.ja: アニには、罠が見えています。地下へ誘導する説明、同期だけの護送、エレンが巨人化する位置。見えすぎた作戦は、捕獲の確実さを自分で削ります。削られた確実さの穴を、エレンの慈悲がさらに広げます。エルヴィンは穴を、感情の失敗としては扱いません。扱いのは、時間です。時間があるうちに合流できる班と、時間がない街路があります。街路のほうは、住民の日常の幅しかありません。幅は、女型の巨人には狭いです。
segments.en: Annie can see the trap. The explanation leading her underground. An escort made only of classmates. The position where Eren is supposed to become a Titan. An operation that can be seen too well cuts its own certainty of capture. Eren's mercy widens the cut certainty further. Erwin does not treat the hole as a failure of emotion. What he treats is time. There are squads that can still join while time remains, and there are streets where time is already gone. The streets have only the width of the residents' ordinary day. That width is narrow for the Female Titan.

segments.ja: エレンは変身の意思を、口では作れます。口の意思が体に届きません。届かない理由を、彼は森の遅れと同じ場所に見つけます。相手が人間だと分かった瞬間に、巨人化の筋肉が拒否します。拒否は、慈悲の体の形です。形は美しくありません。美しい選択の話ではなく、必要な瞬間に世界へ出てこない拳です。出てこないことを、ミカサは言葉で待ちません。待たないことが、次の段です。
segments.en: Eren can make the intention to transform in his mouth. The mouth's intention does not reach the body. He finds the reason it does not reach in the same place as the lateness in the forest. At the moment he knows the opponent is human, the muscle of titanization refuses. The refusal is the bodily shape of mercy. The shape is not beautiful. It is not a story of a beautiful choice. It is a fist that does not come out into the world at the moment it is needed. Mikasa does not wait for that absence in words. Not waiting is the next step.

segments.en: Erwin does not make the first failure into the end of the operation. If it ended, the contents would escape again, and the evidence would become a repeat of the forest. He sorts it this way: the goal remains capture, and only the place has moved from the underground to the city. The sorting is cold. Cold sorting has a danger of making the destruction now happening beyond Nile's screen look small. The Commander knows that danger and still keeps the goal. The reason for keeping it is that the contents who can answer humanity's question are still alive.
